UPDATE retention_run
        SET state = 'idle',
            finished_at = now(),
            locked_until = NULL,
            current_run_id = NULL,
            next_run_at = CASE
                WHEN $5::jsonb IS NULL
                  OR (SELECT r.retention_policy FROM repository r WHERE r.id = $1) = $5::jsonb
                THEN $2
                ELSE retention_run.next_run_at
            END,
            last_run_summary = $3
        WHERE repository_id = $1
          AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR current_run_id = $4)
